messages:
olivia: Quick UX/a11y check on the small quickstart banner that appears on empty projects - current primary CTA text is 'Try sample project' and there's a secondary 'Skip for now' link plus a small 'Use as starter' checkbox beneath it. Posting mock and a11y notes: https://mock.redwood/sample-mini-banner.png

anya: Nice - main Q: where should focus land when the banner appears? Primary CTA or the close control? Also, does the checkbox need to be tabbable before CTA?

sam: From eng: current behavior is focus lands on the close 'x' (we followed previous rule). I'm fine switching to primary CTA. Also need to fix dialog semantics when opening sample - not currently using aria-labelledby. Example quick fix: <div role="dialog" aria-labelledby="sample-title" aria-describedby="sample-desc">

jamal: Research note: users find 'Skip for now' wording fine but it should be visually de-emphasized; make it text-only rather than a button. Also CTA contrast is failing in our color token (checked with a11y-bot).

designbot: Automated accessibility scan: CTA contrast ratio 2.8:1 on current gradient background - fail. Banner lacks aria-live region for dismissal announcements.

olivia: Good catch. Accessibility nit: when user dismisses the banner we should announce 'Sample banner dismissed' via an aria-live polite region so screen-reader users know it changed. Also ensure checkbox has accessible name (e.g., label 'Set as project starter').

anya: Copy tweak proposal: shorten CTA to 'Try sample' or 'Open sample' - 'Try sample project' is a mouthful on small screens. Add one-line hint under CTA: 'Includes prompts & quickstart steps'. Thoughts?

sam: Implementation considerations: sample payloads are lazy-loaded. If we change CTA to open sample immediately, initial load can feel slow. Proposal: prefetch metadata (titles + thumbnails) on banner render, gated by a feature flag for Dedicated customers to avoid extra egress. I'll PR with flag.

jamal: Also check keyboard order: banner tab order should be [CTA, checkbox, Skip, Close]. Close shouldn't be first; otherwise keyboard users keep closing by accident.

olivia: Agreed. Action items - @sam add aria-labelledby + prefetch flag PR and address dialog semantics; @anya finalize exact CTA copy and contrast token (I'll attach token suggestion); @jamal run full a11y sweep after PR; designbot re-run contrast check once styles updated. I'll update the mock with revised focus state and post screenshots here. :v:

sam: Sounds good. I'll aim for a small PR today. :thumbsup:

olivia: Thanks team - catching this before launch saves followups.
